name: Integral Yoga Center Maui
reason: The directory's link (angelyoga.com) is the personal site of one teacher, Meenakshi Angel Honig: private sessions, personalised retreats, nutrition coaching and her books, with no physical school, class schedule or centre on the site. Not a School. Could be a future individual lead (50 years teaching in the Integral Yoga line), though much of the site is diet and stress/health framing.
